prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering steps, adding an estimated countdown on wait screens, pet control tutorial screens, and personality-driven copy improved performance.
Bypassing onboarding steps yielded mixed results, winning in one test but significantly hurting in another.
Major redesigns, account recovery safety hints, and companion benefit story copy significantly hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, permission checks, incentives, guide screens, and most wait info or copy updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions generally overestimated actual gains, but underestimated performance for the pet control tutorial screen, countdown wait info, and personality-driven headlines.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, incentive: +3.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +1.2% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, wait_info: +0.6% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -1.9% over 3 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -0.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: +3.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +2.5% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -12.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +0.6% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.5% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +2.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, incentive: -1.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +7.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.7%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.1%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.6%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Photo style preset selection screen: Insert a new screen before photo upload allowing users to pick a visual rendering style (3D, Pixel, Anime) for their desktop pet. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.3% and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or producing incorrect visual results.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop visibility check sub-flow screen: Add a new setup confirmation screen at the end of onboarding that presents a checklist verifying pet visibility and control menu access. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or failing to open, and 3 emails reported confusion around controlling or hiding the pet.)
2: [choose_path, hint] Companion path selection duration hint: Add a visual hint on the choose_path screen clarifying that path selection takes less than 2 minutes. (why: Users take a mean of 514s on choose_path with a 78.7% conversion rate, showing hesitation early in the funnel.)
3: [adoption, copy] Photo upload clarity and quality guidance: Update headline and body on upload_photos screen to give explicit advice on lighting and front-facing pet photos. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation output looking wrong or failing, contributing to the 69.3% adoption step completion.)
4: [finish, layout] Home welcome checklist layout overhaul: Switch the home_intro screen to a checklist layout detailing core pet actions like dragging, minimizing, and summoning. (why: Finish conversion drops to 71.6% and support received multiple tickets asking how to hide, summon, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop background ready sound chime: Enable background notifications and add an explicit sound component trigger on the waiting screen when pet generation finishes. (why: The waiting screen has an average time of 2336s, suggesting users minimize the desktop app during generation and forget to switch back.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Account sync safety hint on sign in: Add a prominent hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users to sign in with their existing credentials to prevent progress resets. (why: 8 support emails (highest count) complained about pets disappearing or resetting after logging in again.)
